title: Research progress on hydrodeoxygenation of lignin model compounds using microporous molecular sieve-supported metal catalysts
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4588-4613
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00453E, Review Article

Lignin, which is widely present in nature, is a potential alternative to fossil fuels, and its catalytic conversion into high-value-added chemicals or fuels has significant application potential.
